newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending Friday's loss.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending Friday's loss.

text.p: Polish shares were seen extending Friday's loss, signalled by stronger selling after fixing, and analysts said the market would be waiting for more details on how the weekend bout of floods affected the country.
Analysts said the lower severity of the second phase of floods could cheer the market, although losses from the first wave had not yet been counted and should dampen buying.
Polifarb Wroclaw, Rafako, ZEW and Viscoplast which were hit by the first wave of flooding remain suspended until the scope of the damage can be estimated.
